topic: Pathology ensemble redesign — loose ends & next steps
notes:
Bridgecrew-aligned pathology ensemble landed on branch fix/pathology-ensemble (merged to main this session). arch-pathology-rust proven end-to-end to WritePlan (PE-6) — plan at design/refactor/plans/rap-wb-archive-role.md. Loose ends:

1. HETEROGENEOUS LIVE RUN PENDING. The PE-6 plan was produced with the panel+validator temporarily repointed to `codex` because the bro-harness provider path (brodex/deepseek/glm) hit a transient outage ~08:00Z (brodex account probe dropped to 0.0; both old+new harness binaries failed 0s; native claude/codex worked). Catalog restored to heterogeneous providers. Re-run arch-pathology-rust on the real heterogeneous panel once brodex/deepseek/glm are healthy.

2. bro-harness in-band-error fix UNVERIFIED LIVE. anthropic.rs now surfaces+retries in-band SSE error events (overloaded/network) instead of laundering them into empty success (commit cef654a; merged with the peer's 'instrument suspicious turn ends' instrumentation). Unit-tested + builds, but the retry path wasn't exercised live (the outage hit before/around it). Confirm on the next transient overload.

3. PLAN RENDERING. diagnosis_summary/evidence/atom_mapping/remediation/deferred render raw JSON objects (the facilitator Synthesize step emitted arrays of objects; pathology_common::pathology_markdown renders objects as `- \`{json}\``). Contradictions/Refuted render nicely via pathology_findings_markdown. Fix: apply object-aware rendering to those sections too, or constrain the Synthesize prompt to prose strings.

4. OTHER 3 FLOWS NOT YET PROVEN. Only arch-pathology-rust is installed + team-instantiated + smoke-tested. arch-pathology-java, perf-pathology-rust, perf-pathology-java need: install brofiles+panel teamplates+facilitators+workflows, `bro_team create` the panels, and a smoke run each.

5. TEAM INSTANTIATION REQUIREMENT. Ensemble actors resolve `team` via load_team (instantiated teams store) with no teamplate fallback. Adoption requires `bro_team(action=create, name, template)` after installing the teamplate — bbox_artifact_install kind=team and save_template are NOT sufficient, nor is a daemon restart. Consider auto-instantiating on team-artifact install, or codify in the adoption runbook. (design doc updated with the sequence.)

6. FACILITATOR SPURIOUS POST. The facilitator (rust-architecture-pathologist) posts one whiteboard entry during Survey despite the prompt; harmless to the gate (checks lens aliases) but tighten so it doesn't pollute the board / get validated.

7. REAL BUG FOUND (the plan's subject). WhiteboardRegistry::archive advances Resolve->Archived outside the Role::can_transition authority gate that transition enforces, and whiteboard_archive calls it directly. Decide + fix per RAP-WB-001..003 (archive authority contract).

8. DOCS. docs/perf-pathology-dispatch.md still points at the old language-agnostic perf-pathology.json; update to perf-pathology-{rust,java}. perf-pathology.json (v1) left in place, superseded.

9. BUILD HYGIENE. Sharing CARGO_TARGET_DIR across worktrees while a peer has uncommitted edits to a shared crate (bro-tools) produced a false bro-harness build failure (stale/mismatched artifacts). Build the harness in a dedicated target dir when peers are mid-edit on shared crates.

Decomposed during thread triage (2026-06-11) — 10d idle, all live loose ends extracted to repo-owned project gaps: item 7 whiteboard archive authority bug (VERIFIED still present in src/whiteboards.rs:1048 vs :1023) → gap-2ed75162; items 3+6 plan rendering + facilitator spurious post (verified, pathology_common.rs:348) → gap-d062e178; items 1+2+4 heterogeneous live run + in-band-error retry + 3 unproven flows → gap-9d0f9159; item 5 team-instantiation requirement → gap-37a280a6; item 8 stale dispatch doc (verified) → gap-96936c27. Item 9 (CARGO_TARGET_DIR cross-worktree hazard) is superseded by the per-worktree target convention now in CLAUDE.md (fleet/worktree dispatch env convention) — dropped, no gap.
